Eur. 6.2 (Human Rubella Immunoglobulin; Immunoglobuli- num Humanum Rubellae). A liquid or freeze-dried preparation containing immunoglobulins, mainly immunoglobulin G (IgG). It is obtained from plasma containing specific antibodies against the rubella virus. Normal immunoglobulin may be added. It con- tains not less than 4500 international units/mL.
